1.consolidated_definition: Decirle a uno algo que le haga confesar lo que de otro modo hubiera ocultado. Poner a alguien una celada.
1.en_consolidated_definition: To reveal to someone something that would otherwise be concealed, causing them to confess. To set a trap for someone.
